Maya (CS Ops): heads-up — noticed a spike in 'unassigned' accounts after last night's contact-merge run. a lot of renewals showing no owner.
Leo: ack, saw that too in the dashboard. do we have a rollback? :eyes:
Sophia: i'm looking at the merge logs now. suspecting the email-normalization step dropped non-ascii addresses. pulling sample.
Maya (CS Ops): sample would help. renewal team flagged ~40 high-risk accounts that suddenly lost owners.
Jamal: fwiw, the dedupe job ran with the new fuzzy-match threshold (0.78). maybe too aggressive.
Sophia: here's the query i ran to find affected rows:
```sql
SELECT account_id, contact_email, owner_id, merged_at
FROM contact_merges
WHERE merged_at >= '2025-06-11' AND owner_id IS NULL
ORDER BY merged_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Leo: thanks — looks like most dropped owners were on legacy domains with accents (e.g., josé@...).
Maya (CS Ops): can we triage the flagged renewals now? i'll assign temporary owners for outreach.
Jamal: proposed quick fix: revert fuzzy threshold to 0.85 and re-run merge on the subset where owner_id changed in last 24h.
Sophia: agree. i'll push a dry-run first. command i'll run:
```
./scripts/contact-merge --dry-run --since 2025-06-11 --threshold 0.85 > merge-dryrun.log
```
crm-bot: scheduled job "contact-merge" was paused by Sophia at 2025-06-12T02:14:00Z.
Leo: after dry-run, share sample diff and i'll coordinate with renewals on owner reassigns.
Maya (CS Ops): thanks. also can we add a post-merge validation to the playbook: if any high-value account loses owner, alert cs-ops + pager?
Jamal: good idea. quick pseudocode for the check:
```
if merged_account.owner_id IS NULL and account.mrr > 1000:
  send_alert('#cs-ops', merged_account)
```
Sophia: i'll add that to the orchestration step and open a tiny PR. tagging @leo for review.
Leo: i'll review and prioritize the hotfix merge revert.
Maya (CS Ops): i'll create a short runbook for the renewal reps to follow if they see missing owner during outreach. ping me when the dry-run sample is ready. :thumbsup:
crm-bot: note: created incident ticket CS-2025-118 for "contact-merge owner loss".
